United States of America

**Location:**

US-CT-EAST HARTFORD-ETC ~ 400 Main St ~ BLDG ETC

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Confidential

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At **RTX**, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

**Pratt & Whitney** is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Pratt & Whitney is seeking a Senior Manager, Model-Based Quality Deployment, to lead the deployment and adoption of Model-Based Quality (MBQ) capabilities across the organization. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for driving strategic digital transformation initiatives, accelerating implementation of advanced quality technologies, and developing organizational capabilities that support long-term business objectives.

The successful candidate will provide direct leadership to the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, with resources aligned to the module center structure including Cold Section, Hot Section, North Berwick, and Supply Chain. This position requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, organizational influence, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful deployment and sustainment of Model-Based Quality capabilities across programs, sites, and customers.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the Model-Based Quality Deployment Team, providing direct leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management.
* Establish operational priorities, deployment strategies, and resource allocation plans to achieve business and organizational objectives.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of Model-Based Quality tools, technologies, and processes across engineering, quality, operations, manufacturing, and customer organizations.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration to align stakeholders, resolve barriers, and accelerate execution of strategic deployment initiatives.
* Develop team capabilities through talent development, succession planning, training, and employee engagement activities.
* Monitor deployment progress, performance metrics, and organizational adoption to ensure successful execution and sustainment.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quality performance, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with deployment activities while ensuring alignment with program and customer requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and advocate for Model-Based Quality, supporting enterprise digital transformation objectives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer focus across the organization.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10+ years of experience in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Program Management, or a related field; or an Advanced Degree and 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, technology deployments, or business transformation activities.
* Strong knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5), 3D model-based engineering practices, and manufacturing quality requirements within an aerospace or highly regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience developing and executing strategic plans in a manufacturing, quality, or engineering environment.
* Demonstrated leadership experience with direct responsibility for people development, performance management, and team execution.
* Proven ability to lead organizational changes and drive adoption of new technologies and business processes.

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* Demonstrated expertise in Model-Based Quality, Model-Based Enterprise (MBE), Digital Thread, or related digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading teams within aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of Pratt & Whitney quality systems, manufacturing processes, and business operations.
* Experience influencing and aligning stakeholders across multiple organizations and levels of leadership.
* Excellent project management, communication, and organizational leadership skills.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification.
* Experience supporting strategic initiatives across multiple programs, customers, sites, and supply chain partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and data-driven performance management tools.

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. **This position is classified as:**

**Onsite**: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
new_roles.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

*If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e-mail* *to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com*

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations Maintenance
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Manager, Operations Maintenance (Production) is responsible for overseeing and coordinating production personnel activities and ensuring accurate and timely completion of associated documentation in support ofensuring the operation and maintenance of production (prep, compounding, and filling) machinery and mechanical equipment in compliance with all safety policies, cGMPs, and SOPs. This role works cross-functionally with quality, engineering, manufacturing, technical transfer, and validation. The Manager, Operations Maintenance (Production) will rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals, which include organizing hourly employees in the performance of their duties, driving productivity to achieve optimum results, coordinating labor needs in support of minimizing active batch downtime and preventative maintenance schedule attainment. Additionally, the Operations Maintenance Manager (Production) oversees special project for process improvements to the manufacturing process. This position supports the ongoing development, manufacture, and distribution of pharmaceutical products in compliance with local procedures, corporate policies, and the regulatory requirements of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a sterile environment in the clean room by complying with garbing and behavior requirements that align to established cGMP practices and techniques
* Enforce/follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety policies, batch records, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), including Data Integrity and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP)
* Manage the operations maintenance (production) team to perform responsibilities associated with the troubleshooting/repair/preventative maintenance of GMP utilities and GMP pharmaceutical processing equipment, as well as accurate and timely completion of associated documentation
* Ensure operations maintenance (production) team members adequately support the production operations teams (Prep, Compounding and Fill) with equipment changeovers, set-ups, and start-up activities
* Ensure accurate and complete spare parts inventories are maintained
* Plan and execute operations maintenance (production) shut down/start up activities
* Conduct employee reviews and provide coaching as appropriate; maintain performance and attendance records
* Improve existing processes and/or equipment functionality in order to improve operational efficiency
* Assist with deviation investigations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and other documents as needed
* Manage the maintenance operations (production) team to execute support requests from manufacturing, technical transfer, validation, and engineering
* Ensure self and direct reports are trained and work in compliance with applicable SOPs, cGMPs, regulatory requirements, safety, environmental, mechanical/electrical maintenance/troubleshooting principles, and company policies
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Skills:**

* Ability to comply with and enforce aseptic practices and cleanroom behavior
* Ability to lead a maintenance team to efficiently and accurately execute repairs/preventative maintenance activities designed to minimize active batch downtime
* Ability to hold employees accountable for accurate, complete and timely task execution
* Must display sound judgment, ability to seek guidance, and provide clear directions
* Strong analytical, listening, verbal/written communication, achieve accuracy without being rushed, efficient time-management, problem-solving, attention to detail, prioritization, organization, interpersonal, computer and conflict management skills
* Ability to read and understand wiring diagrams and P&ID and possess a basic understanding of mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems
* Knowledge of lock out tag out procedures
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs without assistance

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* BS degree in Engineering (or related field) preferred. An appropriate mix of education and experience in a cGMP manufacturing environment may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* 7+ years industrial maintenance experience (preferably in an aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing environment) and minimally 3-5 years of leadership experience preferred
* Experience with (or knowledge of) programmable logic controllers and/or Distributed Control Systems is preferred
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical manufacturing systems including PMS (particle measuring systems) and air monitoring systems, high purity water systems (WFI), HVAC equipment and systems, compressors, air/gas supply and distribution, plant and clean steam generation and distribution, refrigeration equipment, vacuum systems, and waste collection/drainage systems, as well as pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment (filling machines, washers, loaders, depyrogenation ovens, autoclaves, lyophilizer, etc) is also preferred
* Experience with maintenance and operation of manufacturing equipment in an active aseptic or terminally sterilized manufacturing environment preferred
* Experience with computerized Maintenance Management Systems like Blue Mountain or equivalent preferred

new_roles.title: Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch
new_roles.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**LOCATION:** Remote with Travel

US Valve is growing rapidly, driven by critical customer demand in data center and other high-growth markets, creating increasingly complex new product development programs with multiple manufacturing paths. The Director, NPI Program Management & Manufacturing Launch will build and lead the function responsible for taking these programs from business case through stable production, whether manufactured at US Valve, at sister IDEX business units, through external supply chain partners, or through a hybrid model. The role ensures that product design, manufacturing processes, suppliers, supply chain, quality systems, and commercial launch mature together against one integrated plan.

This leader is the single point of accountability for integrated NPI execution and owns end-to-end program results, including schedule, budget, quality, supplier readiness, manufacturing readiness, launch readiness, and ramp performance. The role organizes Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Sales, Finance, BU partners, and external suppliers under one plan. The Director ensures APQP and launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections, are completed on time and to standard. Success isn't design release; it is demonstrating that the full value stream can repeatedly meet customer demand with the required quality, cost, and delivery performance.

The right leader is a builder and results driver with the technical and operational credibility to walk the factory floor, challenge supplier capacity, identify manufacturing constraints, and lead cross-functional recovery. This person establishes the PMO, sets objective gate criteria and metrics, holds functional leaders and partners accountable without direct authority, challenges unrealistic plans, and leads recovery when programs fall behind. The leader will model IDEX values of trust, team, and excellence and build a high-performing team that scales with the business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Build and Lead the Function***

* Build and lead the Program Management Office (PMO), including organizational structure, staffing plan, talent development, and succession for program and launch managers.
* Establish standard NPD governance—stage-gate/tollgate process, templates, operating cadence, and decision rights—aligned with the IDEX Operating Model.
* Define objective gate-exit criteria and recommend Go, Conditional Go, Hold, or Re-scope decisions based on demonstrated evidence.
* Own the NPD and launch portfolio; prioritize programs using 80/20 principles and align resources to the highest-value customer and growth opportunities.
* Lead executive-level business case, tollgate, and launch-readiness reviews, driving clear decisions on scope, investment, timing, and manufacturing path.

***IDEX Connected Growth and Cross-BU Leadership***

* Drive programs across multiple sister IDEX business units, leveraging IDEX connected growth strategies to share capacity, technology, capabilities, and supply chain.
* Organize and align BU partners, supply chain partners, and internal manufacturing teams into a single integrated execution plan for each program.
* Maintain one integrated critical path and one objective program status across product, supplier, tooling, manufacturing, quality, material, and customer workstreams.
* Lead make, buy, partner, intercompany, and contract manufacturing strategies, including location, capacity, Capex, tooling, staffing, and timing.
* Establish cross-BU agreements, roles, and communication cadences that ensure clear accountability for deliverables across sites and partners.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance to align program strategy with BU and IDEX growth objectives.

***Quality Management and Launch Readiness Across Supply Chain Partners***

* Drive quality management across multiple supply chain partners, sister BUs, and internal sites to ensure consistent standards from development through production.
* Ensure APQP and product launch deliverables are completed on time and to standard, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, process flow diagrams, MSA, capability studies, and first article inspections.
* Partner with Quality and Supply Chain to qualify, develop, and audit suppliers and contract manufacturers, and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Lead launch-readiness and production-readiness gates, ensuring no program advances without required quality, validation, and capacity evidence.
* Separate product validation from production-rate validation; require evidence that the complete value stream can repeatedly achieve required volume, yield, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive post-launch stabilization, ensuring yield, quality, and delivery targets are met before handoff to steady-state operations.

***Advanced Manufacturing and Capacity***

* Identify and drive advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and technologies needed to meet critical customer demand and scale production.
* Drive readiness of critical processes including welding and joining, filtration media and filter manufacturing, precision machining, assembly, automation, and production test.
* Lead capacity planning and implementation of new processes, including equipment selection, CapEx justification, facility changes, validation, and ramp plans.
* Partner with equipment providers, consultants, and IDEX sites to accelerate process development and transfer best practices.
* Champion design for manufacturability, lean, and continuous improvement in all new product introductions.
* Ensure process qualification, fixtures, tooling, controls, operator readiness, capacity, and rate trials are incorporated before design freeze and production release.

***Metrics, Visibility, and Results***

* Define and own program and launch KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that provide clear leadership visibility across BUs and partners.
* Identify risks early—schedule, resource, quality, sourcing, cost, capacity, and production readiness—and drive countermeasures and recovery plans.
* Challenge unrealistic timelines, resource assumptions, and commitments; escalate decisions and support needs to executive leadership.
* Deliver regular executive updates on portfolio status, risks, decisions, and results.
* Travel domestically and internationally up to 25% to support program execution, supplier engagement, site coordination, customer needs, and equipment-provider activities.
* Perform other related duties and support additional program, PMO, or business needs as assigned.

**KEY PERFORMANCE METRICS:**

* On-time milestone and launch attainment across the NPD portfolio.
* PPAP on-time completion and first-pass approval rate across internal sites, sister BUs, and supply chain partners.
* PFMEA, DFMEA, and control plan completion prior to required gates.
* Launch quality, including first-pass yield, PPM, and escapes at launch and 90 days post-launch.
* Ramp-to-rate performance, including time to target capacity and on-time delivery to customers.
* Critical manufacturing process readiness, including qualification and demonstrated capability for welding/joining, filtration manufacturing, machining, assembly, and test as applicable.
* Program budget, Capex, and product cost performance versus business case.
* Supplier and partner quality and delivery performance on launch programs.
* New product and IDEX-connected growth revenue enabled.
* PMO team capability, staffing, and retention.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven leader who has built and scaled a PMO, NPD launch, or program management function in a manufacturing environment.
* undefined
* Deep experience with APQP and product launch deliverables, including PPAP, PFMEA, DFMEA, control plans, and production part qualification.
* Track record driving quality and launch execution across multiple supply chain partners, contract manufacturers, and internal sites.
* Experience identifying and implementing advanced manufacturing processes, automation, and capacity expansions to meet demanding customer ramps.
* undefined
* Demonstrated success leading across multiple business units in a matrixed organization; multi-BU or IDEX experience preferred.
* Strong business acumen in make-versus-buy, multi-site manufacturing, CapEx, tooling, cost, capacity, and risk decisions.
* Builds metrics, dashboards, and operating cadence that drive accountability and measurable results.
* Influential leader able to align executives, BU partners, and suppliers, and hold owners accountable without direct authority.
* Strong executive communicator who turns complex program information into clear decisions and actions.
* Experience with welding/joining, filtration, pneumatics, fluid handling, pumps, compressors, blowers, valves, electromechanical products, precision manufacturing, data center, thermal management, or engineered industrial components preferred.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP certification preferred; working knowledge of the IDEX Operating Model and 80/20 a plus.
* Proficient with project management tools, dashboards, and Microsoft Office applications.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations, supply chain, or a related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of program management, NPD, manufacturing launch, quality, or operations experience, including 5+ years leading teams, with experience in industrialization, supplier development, site transfers, and multi-site manufacturing.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* While performing the duties of the job, the employee is required to move around and be still, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear.
* Employee will occasionally lift up to 35 lbs.
* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering, Primary Care
new_roles.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences.
 
 
The Director, Segment Quality Engineering is a strategic technology leader responsible for advancing quality engineering practices across a defined portion of Humana’s technology portfolio. Reporting to the AVP, Quality Engineering – Segment, this role will lead teams responsible for delivery quality, test automation, release readiness, and continuous improvement across multiple product and application teams.
 
 
This leader will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Platform, DevOps, and enterprise quality partners to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and improve release confidence, delivery speed, and production stability.

**Responsibilities**

 

* Lead quality engineering strategy and execution across a defined portfolio, domain, or segment.
* Lead and develop quality engineering managers, leads, engineers, and SDETs; drive organization design, talent growth, and team performance.
* Establish portfolio quality goals, KPIs, and governance to improve delivery quality, release readiness, and production stability.
* Embed built-in quality across planning, design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Oversee test strategy and execution across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and release validation.
* Own portfolio-level quality risk management, including defect trends, release concerns, environment issues, and cross-team dependencies.
* Drive automation-first practices and integrate quality signals, validation, and gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Lead adoption of AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities and promote innovative practices that improve speed, coverage, and reliability.
* Sponsor modernization of quality frameworks, tooling, and test approaches for APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
* Oversee non-functional quality practices, including performance, resiliency, operational readiness, and security validation.
* Use metrics and production insights to drive continuous improvement, maturity, and investment priorities.
* Partner with segment and enterprise stakeholders to align execution with broader quality engineering strategy, standards, and reference architecture direction.
* Ensure responsible adoption of AI and compliance with applicable security, privacy, regulatory, and operational standards.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

 

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, testing, or related technical disciplines.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing quality engineering, test automation, or software delivery teams in large enterprise environments.
* Experience leading quality engineering execution across multiple agile teams or a complex application/product portfolio.
* Demonstrated success driving quality engineering modernization, including automation, tooling, process improvement, and metrics-driven execution.
* Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience with API, UI, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing approaches.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and modern application architectures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
* Experience working in matrixed organizations and leading geographically distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Familiarity with member, provider, digital experience, or enterprise platform domains.
* Experience with enterprise quality tools, test management platforms, and engineering lifecycle tools.
* Knowledge of microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience supporting non-functional testing, including performance and resiliency.
* Exposure to AI-enabled quality engineering or intelligent automation capabilities.
* Familiarity with enterprise reference architecture principles, patterns, and standards in cloud, hybrid, on-premise, and SaaS environments.

**Success in this Role**

 

* In this role, success will be measured by:
* Improved release stability and delivery quality across the assigned portfolio.
* Reduced escaped defects and production incidents related to delivery quality.
* Increased automation adoption, regression reliability, and validation efficiency.
* Stronger integration of quality engineering into engineering workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Advancement of quality engineering maturity and consistent execution across teams.
* Positive stakeholder partnership and strong team engagement and development outcomes.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. 
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. 
$156,600 - $215,400 per year 
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

**About us**
============

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

new_roles.title: Director, Business Ops & Analytics - Talent Operations, Governance & Enablement
new_roles.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast. 
**Job Summary**

Own the operating systems, governance, controls, enablement, and execution disciplines that allow Talent to deliver strategy consistently, safely, efficiently, and at scale. Translate Talent strategy and enterprise requirements into clear operating models, processes, controls, decision rights, knowledge, readiness, and adoption mechanisms while protecting regulatory, compliance, and business-continuity obligations.

**Job Description**

**Key Accountabilities:**

* **Design and govern the Talent operating model**, establishing clear processes, standards, decision rights, ownership, handoffs, and escalation mechanisms across Talent.
* **Own the Talent compliance operating framework**, translating Legal and Compliance requirements into operational controls, monitoring, documentation, evidence, and sustainable Talent practices.
* **Lead Talent audit readiness and coordination**, maintaining visibility to compliance obligations, control ownership, audit evidence, findings, remediation, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Provide governance and execution discipline for strategic programs**, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, risks, decisions, readiness, and accountability.
* **Lead organizational and operational readiness**, ensuring new processes, technologies, automation, and strategic programs can be successfully implemented and sustained.
* **Own change, adoption, and enablement disciplines**, translating organizational change into the knowledge, capabilities, communications, tools, and reinforcement required for successful execution.
* **Govern Talent knowledge and process architecture**, establishing trusted sources of truth, documentation standards, knowledge ownership, and scalable access to policies, processes, and guidance.
* **Drive process optimization and continuous improvement**, identifying friction, simplifying work, standardizing execution, and partnering with Technology & Automation partners to embed processes and controls into systems.
* **Own or coordinate Talent business continuity, operational risk, and records-management requirements** within the Talent operating environment.
* **Establish and govern the Talent responsibility model for AI-enabled work**, ensuring clear human accountability as automation scales through defined decision rights, policy and control logic, data and knowledge integrity, exception management, escalation paths, documentation, and ongoing oversight of AI-enabled processes and outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Directing the implementation of operational policies to enhance organizational effectiveness and strategic execution
* Leading the design and execution of business strategies to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness
* Guiding cross-functional teams in the integration of analytics for robust strategic decision-making support
* Driving the optimization of business processes to improve overall performance and market positioning
* Championing the adoption of innovative operational practices to maintain a leading edge in business operations
* Steering the evaluation and refinement of operational policies to support dynamic business needs
* Cultivating a culture of continuous improvement to foster operational excellence and strategic growth
* Facilitating the alignment of financial and business analytics to inform and influence key strategic initiatives
* Managing the analysis and communication of management data to support operational decisions and highlight areas for improvement
* Aligning business processes within functional areas to the broader strategic objectives of the organization
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Skills:**

Executive Leadership; Operational Excellence; Advanced Analytics; Business Process Improvements; Financial Management; People Management; Organizational Change Management

**Salary:**

Pay Range: This job can be performed in Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Washington, and Denver Campus with a Pay Range of $132,421.96 - $248,291.18. This job can be performed in California with a good faith estimated pay range upon hire of $119,179.77 USD - $220,703.27.

Comcast intends to offer the selected candidate base pay within the posted range for this role at the time of posting dependent on job-related, non-discriminatory factors such as experience. The application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. new_roles.title: Senior Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in safety, productivity, product quality, customer service, quality of work life, and lowering manufacturing costs.
* Works closely with sales and finance teams to ensure seamless start-ups of new products on-time and at optimized costs.
* Role models ownership, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
* Provides support and guidance in the management of product quality and ensures compliance with quality and sanitation policies, procedures, and systems to include HACCP, GMPs and the management and reduction of consumer complaints.
* Ensures all performance issues are addressed in a timely manner and all employees adhere to company policies and procedures on an ongoing basis.
* Ensure compliance with all FDA, OSHA, local regulatory agencies and auditing requirements.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or manufacturing or related field of study.
* Experience with plant transformation including organizational design, facility enhancement and upskilling and development of the workforce. Track record of delivering significant business KPI goals in turnaround opportunities.
* Proven leadership skills to put employees first, ability to remove barriers and promote succession planning
* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.
* Able to simply and effectively communicate complex issues up, down and across the organization.
* High degree of financial acumen is required with the ability to perform plant-level financial analysis.
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer skills including MS Office programs such as Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical / problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to empower, motivate and inspire staff.
* Ability to lead change and execute strategic decisions.

**Preferred:**

* MBA preferred, but not required
* TPM, TQM, IWS, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Organizational Performance Design capability

**Work Environment:**

* This position works in both office AND manufacturing floor environments.
* Evening and weekend work may be required on an as needed basis
* Travel up to 30%

*Tandem Foods is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 
 
Compensation: $201,500.00 - $277,000.00

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell is a leading Mexican-inspired quick service restaurant brand that is a part of Yum! Brands, Inc. which includes Pizza Hut and KFC. Founded on innovation and passion with Glen Bell bringing tacos to the masses in a world of hot dog and hamburger stands in 1962, today we have nearly 7000 restaurants in the United States and over 400 restaurants in 27 countries outside of the United States. The future holds 2,000 more restaurants across the globe within the next decade. It's easy to see we're in the business of making tacos, but at heart, we're a business that's fueled by the Live Mas energy and passion of people serving people.

What is "Live Mas"?

Equally important to the job role and responsibilities is making sure the Director of Operations can represent the amazing Live Mas! culture that is Taco Bell. At Taco Bell, we embrace breakthrough thinking and innovative ideas that continue to differentiate us from our competitors. We have a maniacal focus on our customers, never follow, and always celebrate the accomplishments of our people. If you want to have fun serving great food to our customers, we would love to meet with you.

Job Description:

About this Job: Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations is responsible for all aspects of operations including people, customers, sales and profits. This leader has up to 3 area coaches as direct reports compiling 12 restaurants. They drive excellence in day-to-day operations; hire, train, coach, & support managers; plan and set goals; focus on problem solving/process improvement; set standards; recognize and motivate area managers, unit level management & their teams. Influence people to drive business results and franchise partnership

The Day-to-Day:

Build People Capability

* Recruit and equip the best operators in the world to deliver great customer experiences
* Build a healthy and robust bench of developed and capable Managers
* Hold Area Coaches accountable for people, customer, sales and profit targets
* Lead by example be a culture champion and live by Taco Bell principles
* Leverage culture and people capability to fuel brand performance
* Resolution oriented in all Employee Relations (ER) activities; provides needed
ER assistance to managers; proactive in addressing ER needs in the market 

 

Deliver a Consistent Customer Experience

* Provides leadership for each manager in the market to ensure customer satisfaction
* Leverage customer programs to coach and improve on execution opportunities
* Train, coach and hold accountable Area Coaches and Restaurant Managers for executing the Taco Bell Operating System and delivering Brand Standards including food safety
* Identify and act with urgency to resolve Brand protection issues
* Excellent execution of Global Operating System initiatives
* Absolutely uncompromising execution of the highest standards of their local regulation around occupational safety and health standards for employee working conditions, and their company safety and security policy

Grow the Brand, Sales, and Profits

* Partners with each Manager in the market to build sales over last year's sales achievement
* Training and operations execution of marketing promotions
* Train and coach Area Coaches how to teach RGMs to use the tools and processes to improve restaurant financial results
* Coach to deliver restaurant profit targets in every restaurant
* Leads the way by working with each Area Coach in the market to deliver profit goals and meet targeted flow-thru objectives; utilizes available reports to identify opportunities; encourages a top-line orientation through operational focus; ensures that correct operational procedures are followed at all times
* Build capability to improve problem solving and planning skills through hands-on demonstrations
* Exhibits ownership working with Management to resolve chronic Repair & Maintenance issues; determines causes of excessive R&M; gathers R&M issues; identifies trends and takes to R&M Business Partners

Minimum Requirements-

Is This You?

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* Strong Quick Service Restaurant Experience, balancing product quality with fast service times
* Is a Dynamic, energetic and positive leader, a self-starter, proactively driven to get things done and does the right thing for the business
* Exhibits unrivaled leadership behaviors; providing coaching, developing the team, driving culture, problem solving, strong communication, time management, executing tasks and achieving results through others
* 10+ years Restaurant Management experience with strong people growing record, recruiting talent, development and performance management
* Corporate restaurant company field operations leader experience
* Has lead multiple managers of multiple high volume units in an area
* Extensive Area Coach experience leading 6-8 restaurant general managers
* Has personally ran a successful restaurant and has knowledge of restaurant operations and expectations for team member's positions
* Corporate office Cross-Functional leading teams experience
* Good communication skills, and strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills with exceptional team building capability

Why Taco Bell?

We truly believe that where you work matters, and we know a thing or two about what makes employees happy. Join us on our mission of feeding people's lives with Mas!

* We are about more than just building restaurantswe connect with our fans through their passions including sports, gaming, and music
* We know that employees want a company they can live and grow with; they crave a unique culture that fosters creativity and encourages pursuit of passion, and they look for opportunities to take risks, develop skills and learn in ways that fit their lifestyle
* We foster a culture of authenticity and believe all people can make a difference

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Director, Operational Excellence**

We're advancing cancer care through innovative screening and diagnostic tests that help patients and healthcare providers make informed decisions before, during and after a cancer diagnosis. Our growing portfolio includes Cologuard®, Oncotype DX®, Cancerguard® and Oncodetect®, along with advanced genetic testing, supporting patients from cancer prevention and early detection through personalized treatment decisions and recurrence monitoring. We're focused on helping more people take action against cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages, so they can live longer, healthier lives.

This role is based on-site in Madison, WI.

**Position Overview**

Abbott is seeking a Director, Operational Excellence to lead the development, implementation, and sustainability of operational excellence practices across our Cancer Diagnostics operations.

This leader will partner closely with operations leadership and frontline teams to strengthen daily management practices, improve operational performance, and build a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the implementation of operational excellence practices that improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and sustain tiered management routines, visual performance boards, standardized metrics, and structured performance reviews across hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
* Partner with operations leaders to implement supervisor standard work, strengthen accountability, and develop consistent problem-solving and performance management practices.
* Apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve process flow, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and drive measurable operational results.
* Establish employee-driven improvement programs that encourage frontline participation, idea generation, and ownership of operational improvements.
* Lead change management efforts that ensure new processes are adopted, embedded into daily operations, and sustained over time.
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to align improvement initiatives with business priorities.
* Lead and coach a team of operational excellence professionals while building continuous improvement capabilities across the broader organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree in a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
* Significant progressive experience in operations leadership, operational excellence, or continuous improvement within a manufacturing, laboratory, or complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and sustaining Lean practices, daily management systems, visual performance management, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience leading operational teams or working directly with frontline leaders to drive measurable performance improvements.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build accountability.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct leadership experience in manufacturing, laboratory, or other high-volume operations.
* Experience in regulated industries such as diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience implementing tiered management systems, supervisor standard work, and employee-driven continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated success sustaining operational improvements through frontline engagement and leadership ownership.

The base pay for this position is $149,300.00 – $298,700.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

new_roles.title: Director - Corporate Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Description**

#### **Position Summary**

The Director of Corporate Continuous Improvement (CI) leads MacAllister's enterprise CI strategy, Corporate CI team, and improvement portfolio. In partnership with the owner, executive team, and divisional leaders, the Director helps establish and build alignment around MacAllister's CI vision, strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap. The Director identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, builds organizational problem-solving capability, and leads improvement work from opportunity identification through execution and sustainment.

The role establishes CI standards, tools, and training; coaches, mentors, and influences leaders and teams across the organization; and communicates CI priorities, results, and opportunities for support.

The ultimate objective is to build and sustain a culture in which continuous improvement becomes habitual and is reflected in how leaders and employees think, act, solve problems, and improve the way work gets done.

#### **Position Duties/Responsibilities**

Primary Responsibilities:

* Partner with the executive team, and divisional leaders to develop and maintain MacAllister's CI strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and operating model aligned with company goals. Build leadership alignment and shared ownership of CI priorities and expectations across the organization.
* Own CI project identification, prioritization, approval, execution, and close-out, focusing on where CI creates the most value; support employee-driven improvement alongside leader-sponsored initiatives.
* Maintain consistent project close-out documenting results, lessons learned, and sustainment plans; verify improvements and results are sustained and take corrective action as needed.
* Set organization-wide CI standards, tools, and terminology; guide Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA application grounded in facts, data, and root cause analysis; coach project teams and facilitate select high-impact improvement events.
* Lead improvement-related change management, engaging affected employees early and ensuring process adoption and sustainment.
* Oversee CI training tailored to responsibility levels using consistent terminology and live projects; coach and support CI-trained departmental leaders who remain in their home departments outside CI.
* Define CI value primarily through capability measures-leaders solving problems independently, AI use cases adopted, and idea-to-approval cycle time-with financial results as supporting evidence.
* Communicate CI initiatives, results, and available support so leaders know when and how to engage the team; share success stories and recognize improvement contributors.
* Use coaching-first leadership to build team autonomy, confidence, and influence; foster problem reporting, experimentation, and learning from mistakes by supporting people publicly and coaching privately.
* Hire, develop, and manage CI personnel; oversee budget, resource allocation, and team structure as needs evolve.
* Play a leadership role in MacAllister's Center of Practice for CI, AI, and problem-solving leadership, incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into CI methods where they improve problem solving, decision making, or productivity. Partner with MacAllister's enterprise AI leadership on broader AI strategy, standards, and adoption.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

* Directly supervises the Corporate CI team and oversees day-to-day operations of the CI department. Mentors and coaches CI team members to strengthen their capabilities as problem solvers, facilitators, coaches, and trusted business partners.
* Reviews and evaluates the work and performance of reporting employees; has authority for hiring and disciplinary actions.

#### **Position Requirements**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years or more of experience in continuous improvement, operations, or business transformation.
* 5 years or more of experience leading leaders.
* Proven success coaching others to identify and solve problems independently.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA.
* A valid driver's license.

Preferred:

* Master's degree in business or a related discipline.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt or equivalent depth of experience designing and delivering CI training.
* Experience at a Caterpillar dealership or in the equipment sales, service, or rental industry.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen problem solving, process improvement, decision support, and organizational productivity. Experience applying AI in these areas is preferred but not required.
* Experience building on an existing CI function and growing its influence across a multi-location organization.

#### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong coaching and leadership development skills; leads through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to connect improvement work to business priorities and help leaders choose where to focus.
* Curiosity about and practical comfort with AI as a business tool.
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills with all levels, from the front line to executives.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with executives, senior managers, and teams.
* Respect for existing culture and relationships, with the judgment to improve without unnecessary disruption.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
* Effective computer skills with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn proprietary systems.

#### **Other Requirements of Position**

* Works under broad supervision. Designs and carries out programs and far-reaching objectives independently, informing management as appropriate.
* Major responsibilities require a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
* If an error is made while in this position, it will require some effort to identify and can significantly impact the company financially.
* Frequently communicates with coworkers, customers, company executives, and management.
* Maintain equipment and supplies to avoid waste, damage to areas and equipment, and to prevent accidents.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this posting are not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs.

values
