existing_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
existing_roles.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**  
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**  
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**  
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

  

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director – Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

  

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

  

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer – vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com (mailto:hr@campsystems.com).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

The Vice President of Operations at Piston Interiors is a key member of the executive leadership team, reporting directly to the President. The VP of Operations leads Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and launch execution; drives Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, Profitability, and Customer Performance; and builds a culture of disciplined continuous improvement, leadership accountability, and reliable execution. Candidate must be located in Acuna, Mexico or Metro-Detroit, United States to be considered for this position. Relocation will be considered.

Responsibilities:

**Strategic Operations Leadership**
  

* Serve as the senior-most Operations executive for Piston Int eriors, setting enterprise direction across U.S. and Mexico

operations and maintaining direct accountability for manufacturing and distribution performance across all locations.
  

* Establish a clear manufacturing approach and translate business strategy into annual operating plans, budgets, capital

priorities, capacity decisions, and measurable operating objectives.
  

* Advise the President and executive leadership team on operating performance, customer commitments, risk, growth

readiness, resource requirements, and strategic opportunities.

**Multi-Site Operations & Performance Accountability**

attainment, scrap, premium freight, inventory, throughput, and profitability.

escalation routines, and corrective-action discipline across the operating network.
  

* Ensure safe working conditions, regulatory and legal compliance, ethical conduct, operational continuity, and reliable

delivery of customer commitments.

structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, and continuous improvement.
  

* Use operational data and technology to improve labor utilization, first-pass yield, scrap, downtime, throughput,

delivery, quality, and profitability expectations.

* Inspire a culture of winning, disciplined execution, continuous improvement, trust, and collaboration while maintaining

* Build credibility with customers, employees, executive leaders, suppliers, and community stakeholders through

transparent communication, predictable results, ethical leadership, and decisive action.

Qualifications:

**Education / Experience / Skills & Abilities**
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field;

Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience within automotive manufacturing,

including significant multi-site responsibility and leadership through other leaders.
  

* Automotive Tier 1 supplier experience required, with direct accountability for manufacturing, quality, industrial

engineering, supply chain, program/launch execution, customer delivery, and plant financial performance.
  

* Demonstrated profit-and-loss leadership, including budgeting, forecasting, labor management, working capital, capital

planning, cost reduction, and profitability improvement.
  

* Proven success implementing lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, daily management systems, and plant or

* Significant experience leading U.S.-Mexico cross-border manufacturing operations; experience within an IMMEX

* Experience in automotive interiors, cut-and-sew, seat trim, visors, leather/vinyl processing, or other labor-intensive

manufacturing strongly preferred.

influence, negotiate, and build trust across all organizational levels and stakeholders.

existing_roles.title: Director, PXT - Amazon Leo Production Operations
existing_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon has committed more than $10 billion to Amazon Leo, a low Earth orbit satellite network designed to bring fast, affordable broadband to customers around the world. Production Operations is where that ambition becomes physical. Every Leo satellite weighs more than 1,000 pounds, contains roughly 4 million individual components, and is designed and built in-house on a 172,000 square foot custom production line in Kirkland, Washington, capable of producing up to five satellite a day. The team completed its 1,000th satellite in September 2026 (https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-builds-satellites), making Leo one of the largest and most advanced satellite production operations in the world.  
From the factory, satellites move to a 100,000 square foot payload processing facility at Kennedy Space Center in Florida that can support three launch campaigns at once, and to launch operations in French Guiana. With more than 80 launches secured across four launch providers, Leo plans to double its launch rate to more than 20 missions in its second year. The organization spans eight sites today across multiple states and ground stations across multiple countries, with more investments coming through in the times ahead.  
This role builds on Amazon's deep operations heritage and takes it to newer heights. You will partner with an organization that brings together aerospace, RF, supply chain and manufacturing experts, recruited from the leading space and defense companies, alongside a skilled hourly production and launch workforce building and launching satellite in clean rooms, across shifts, and on mission-critical launch campaigns. Few people leaders anywhere get to shape all of this at once: precision satellite manufacturing across multiple satellite generations, export-controlled and government production, and Amazon Leo's first employing entity outside the US.  
The people decisions made in the next 18 months will shape this organization for the next decade. As the senior PXT leader for Production Operations, you will make them alongside the VP of Production Operations and the multiple Directors who lead satellite manufacturing, launch operations, supply chain, quality, ground gateways, global trade and compliance, enterprise technology, and Manufacturing Systems Engineering and New Product Introduction. You won't be inheriting a playbook. You'll be writing it.  
What makes this role unique  

* Two talent markets, one interwoven strategy. Build differentiated people programs for a highly technical corporate workforce competing in one of the most constrained talent markets in the world, and for a large, fast growing hourly manufacturing and launch workforce, under a single coherent people strategy.
* Organization design at a defining moment. Shape org design, leadership formation, and succession as the organization scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production in parallel, with a leadership team forming as it grows.
* People infrastructure Amazon has never built. Create job families, compensation, and career frameworks for roles Amazon has never hired before, people processes for export-controlled and cleared work, and Amazon Leo's first non-US employing entity at a launch site.
* Proactive employee and labor relations. Set a direct-engagement and labor relations strategy for an hourly workforce, across factories and launch sites in multiple states and countries.

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as strategic people partner to the VP of Production Operations and Director-level function leaders, advising on organizational design, talent architecture, site strategy, and workforce planning across corporate technical and hourly populations.
* Shape the multi-year organization design for Production Operations as it scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production, including new leadership roles and structures.
* Lead talent strategy for specialized technical roles (aerospace manufacturing, RF and telecommunications engineering, satellite quality, supply chain and trade compliance, AI and automation), competing against established aerospace and defense employers.
* Build scalable HR infrastructure for a 24/7 manufacturing and launch operation, including new-to-Amazon approaches to timekeeping, attendance, performance management, and shift support.
* Lead people strategy for Launch Operations, including sustainable staffing models for launch campaigns, rotational teams, off-shift coverage, and recurring travel.
* Set a proactive labor and employee relations strategy in partnership with Global Employee Relations and Labor Relations, coaching senior operations leaders on direct employee engagement at every site.
* Define people requirements for export-controlled and government manufacturing, including security clearances, cleared hiring pipelines, and compliant people processes, with Legal and Security.
* Stand up Amazon Leo's first non-US employee population at an international launch site, including employment contracts, compensation and benefits, payroll, and statutory compliance.
* Drive leadership development, calibration, promotion readiness, and succession planning across a rapidly expanding senior leadership bench.
* Build and lead a team of HR Business Partners, operating through a deep matrix across HR Partners, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Talent Management, Employee Relations, PXT Technology, and international partners.

  
Click the link to see how Amazon’s growing constellation of custom-built satellites will work together to bring internet connectivity anywhere on the planet: https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-satellite-internet-works

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 15+ years of progressive human resources experience
* 10+ years of experience as an HR business partner supporting senior executives
* 7+ years of experience leading HR strategy for large-scale manufacturing, production, or operations organizations with hourly or shift-based workforces
* 5+ years of experience leading HR strategy for organizations operating across multiple countries and legal entities
* Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Human Resources or MBA
* Experience with employee and labor relations in union represented or union-exposed environments
* Experience designing organizational structures, compensation frameworks, and job architecture for large, fast-growing organizations
* Experience leading people strategy in aerospace, defense, satellite, telecommunications, or advanced manufacturing
* Experience supporting highly technical engineering populations alongside hourly production workforces
* Experience supporting launch, flight, field, or campaign-based operations with rotational or travel-intensive staffing
* Experience designing people processes for export-controlled (ITAR/EAR) or government cleared work environments
* Experience standing up new sites, greenfield operations, or new country employing entities
* Track record of building senior leadership teams and coaching executives through rapid organizational change
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and to build mechanisms that scale beyond any single leader

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. existing_roles.description:
**Compensation Range**

$240,000 - $280,000 / Year

**Overview**

**At The Cheesecake Factory Bakery, We Don't Do Ordinary!** Nothing is scaled down. Not the pride, not the fun, and definitely not the teamwork. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of our Bakery business, lead great people, and strengthen the systems behind the iconic cheesecakes our guests have loved for decades.

**As the VP, Quality Assurance & Food Safety**, you’ll report to the Bakery President and lead food safety, quality assurance, sanitation, and technical services across two bakery plants totaling more than 160,000 square feet and supporting more than 600 staff members. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact: setting the strategy, rebuilding organizational trust, strengthening audit readiness, and elevating Good Manufacturing Practices through disciplined root cause analysis and corrective action. You’ll operate at both the executive and plant levels, bringing the leadership, technical expertise, and influence needed to create lasting change.

**You’ll thrive in this position if you are:**

* **A Trusted Executive Leader:** You build credibility through transparency, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through, earning the confidence to influence decisions at every level.
* **A Strategic, Hands-On Quality Leader:** You set the vision while staying connected to operations, understanding risk, removing barriers, and translating strategy into consistent execution.
* **An Audit and Compliance Expert:** You build a culture of year-round readiness where issues are identified early, corrective actions are effective, and findings are sustainably closed.
* **A Disciplined Problem Solver:** You look beyond the immediate issue, using data, risk assessment, and root cause analysis to solve systemic problems and prevent recurrence.

**Responsibilities**

* Set and lead the Bakery division’s Quality Assurance and Food Safety strategy across both facilities, establishing clear expectations for risk management, performance, and accountability.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the Bakery President and executive leadership, providing clear perspective on food safety and quality risks, audit readiness, significant incidents, and corrective actions.
* Ensure trust and confidence in the function through technical credibility, transparency, strong partnerships, and consistent execution.
* Strengthen compliance and operational discipline across GMPs, HACCP, SQF, AIB, sanitation, allergen controls, environmental monitoring, traceability, supplier quality, microbiological testing, and recall readiness.
* Establish sustained audit readiness and ensure findings have clear ownership, effective corrective actions, and lasting resolution.
* Ensure highly systematic and disciplined adherence to product and process standards on a real-time basis to guarantee our cakes are beautiful and delicious.
* Build greater rigor around root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions, addressing systemic issues rather than symptoms.
* Provide leadership across product and process quality, customer complaints, foreign-material controls, product holds, specifications, labeling, formulas, recipes, and Technical Services.
* Establish meaningful metrics and use data to identify trends, prioritize risk, and hold the organization accountable for results.
* Lead significant food safety, quality, sanitation, and regulatory matters with urgency, sound judgment, and appropriate escalation.
* Build and develop a high-performing Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Sanitation, and Technical Services organization with the talent and capabilities needed for long-term success.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Research and Development, and Human Resources to strengthen ownership and accountability for food safety and quality across the business.
* Prioritize resources and investments against the greatest risks and opportunities while effectively managing the function’s budget.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Sanitation, or Technical Services within food manufacturing, including senior-level, multi-site responsibility.
* Demonstrated success leading food safety and quality strategy, organizational transformation, culture improvement, and high-performing technical teams.
* Deep expertise in GMPs, HACCP, preventive controls, sanitation, microbiological risk, allergen management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recalls, supplier quality, AIB, SQF, and food safety management systems.
* Extensive experience leading regulatory, certification, customer, and internal audits from preparation through corrective action and sustainable closure.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, risk assessment, and incident investigation.
* Proven ability to build organizational trust, strengthen accountability, influence senior leaders, and lead through significant change.
* Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, chemistry, food science, food safety, biology, engineering, or a closely related discipline.

**What we prefer:**

  

* Leadership experience within the bakery or dessert industry; experience in similarly complex food-manufacturing environments will also be considered.
* Master’s degree in a related technical or business discipline.
* Relevant certifications such as SQF Practitioner, HACCP, PCQI, or Certified Food Scientist.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Benefits**

* Eligible to participate in an annual incentive bonus program
* Eligible for an annual long-term equity award in accordance with company Plan and approval process.
* Medical, Dental & Vision
* Access to a company car or car allowance
* Eligible for benefits on the first day of the month following date of hire
* Flexible vacation
* 5 days of sick time per year (first year prorated)
* Tuition Reimbursement of $2,500 for qualified programs
* Adoption Assistance Benefit of $2,500
* 25%-35% discount when dining as a guest
* Reusable gift card loaded annually for your dining enjoyment

**About the Company**

The Cheesecake Factory Bakery creates over 35,000 delicious cheesecakes per day across our two facilities in Calabasas, CA and Rocky Mount, NC plus other baked products for our restaurants, international licensees, and third-party bakery customers.  
  
The Cheesecake Factory Bakery is a subsidiary of The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated. Recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® since 2014, The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a global $3.8 billion public company with more than 370 casual dining restaurants and over 48,000 staff members.  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming workplace for all. We welcome applicants from a wide variety of identities, ideas, perspectives, backgrounds and experiences to apply. The Cheesecake Factory offers reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities.  
  
#SoCheesecake #LifeAtCheesecake  
  
To notify of a non-compliant job posting, please send a notice to ats@thecheesecakefactory.com.

Vice President of Operations

**Good Hearts Gear**

Position Summary

Good Hearts Gear is seeking a strategic, hands-on Vice President of Operations to lead and scale our operational infrastructure. This executive will oversee day-to-day operations while building the systems, processes, and performance standards needed to support growth, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and healthy margins.

The VP of Operations will lead key functions including supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, vendor management, production coordination, process improvement, and customer support operations. This role will also oversee the operational execution of private label and custom product programs, ensuring strong quality, timelines, and scalable processes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced operations leader who can think strategically, execute effectively, and collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, e-commerce, and leadership to support revenue growth and product launch success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage overall operations for Good Hearts Gear, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and scalability
* Develop and improve operational systems, workflows, SOPs, controls, and KPIs
* Oversee inventory planning, purchasing, fulfillment, logistics, warehousing, and vendor performance
* Improve inventory accuracy, service levels, order accuracy, and cost efficiency
* Lead operational execution for private label and custom product initiatives from development through delivery
* Manage vendor and factory relationships, production timelines, quality standards, sampling, and compliance
* Build repeatable processes for product specifications, approvals, launch readiness, and fulfillment
* Partner with sales, marketing, and e-commerce teams to align operations with demand planning, promotions, launches, and customer expectations
* Monitor operational performance, margin support, productivity, and service quality through dashboards and reporting
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team focused on accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, including 3–5 years in a senior leadership role
* Experience in apparel, branded merchandise, promotional products, consumer products, e-commerce, distribution, or light manufacturing strongly preferred
* Proven success managing supply chain, inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, and vendor relationships
* Experience supporting private label, custom product programs, and product development operations
* Strong background in process improvement, SOP development, KPI reporting, and operational scaling
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with sales, marketing, e-commerce, and finance
* Familiarity with ERP, inventory management, order management, and reporting systems
* Experience supporting wholesale and/or big box retail requirements is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field preferred

**Key Skills**

* Strategic operations leadership
* Supply chain and inventory management
* Fulfillment and distribution optimization
* Private label and custom product operations
* Vendor and factory management
* Product development coordination
* Process improvement and performance management
* Financial and margin awareness
* Cross-functional leadership and executive communication

existing_roles.title: Director, Plant Operations
existing_roles.description:
CTI Foods Overview:

Welcome to CTI Foods, where quality, service, and people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a leading food manufacturing company, dedicated to providing our customers with the best possible products and our employees with a rewarding career.

At CTI, we passionately believe that people are our #1 ingredient. We provide a positive and supportive work environment, opportunities for growth and advancement, and a competitive compensation package. We value our employees' contributions and strive to create a culture of respect, teamwork, and excellence.

Whether you're interested in a career in production, quality control, or management, we have a variety of opportunities available. We believe that our success is a result of our focus on quality, service, and people, and we look forward to continuing to serve our customers and employees with excellence.

If you're looking for a rewarding career in the food manufacturing industry, look no further than CTI Foods! Join our team and become a part of a company that values quality, service, and people.

Job Overview:

To lead and direct production and maintenance functions for the respective location, while supporting and adhering to the efforts of safety, food safety, supply chain, human resources, and commercialization, in order to meet location’s business objectives as established by the Senior Leadership Team.

Responsibilities:

* Direct daily operations while maintaining compliance to quality and regulatory standards.
* Execute all plans and initiatives as directed by safety, supply chain, food safety, HR and other cross functional areas.
* Achieve all location KPIs.
* Achieve budget for all operating costs including manufacturing, maintenance, and labor.
* Champion and model the CTI culture and the necessary mindsets to (3Fs) to deliver optimal results.
* Actively participate and engage with other plant leaders for best practice sharing and replication for areas such as network optimization and asset efficiency.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts around plant performance, people and processes to execute on current goals and to prepare for future growth.
* Lead team by effectively utilizing CTI’s Operating Principles.
* Attract, hire and lead the supervisory teams throughout the location, ensuring that all team members are knowledgeable with operating processes and procedures.
* Ability to develop the maintenance department into a pro-active / asset life management model.
* Identify, study and determine the processing equipment that best meets production needs from a product quality and productivity standpoint.
* Play a key role on major CAPEX project budgeting and large project management to ensure timely completion and on budget.
* Define and model the overall facility capacity to have an overall understanding of bottlenecks and limitations.
* Knowledge of USDA-FSIS regulations and ability to work with USDA inspectors on an ongoing basis to ensure compliance to all USDA regulations and HACCP and SQF requirements.
* Knowledge of other regulatory requirements, including OSHA and EPA/DNR. OSHA experience covering worker safety in a protein processing environment as well as ammonia-based refrigeration. EPA/DNR as it pertains to plant discharges either by air or water.
* Maintains continuity among work teams by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and continuing needs.
* Any other duties as assigned.

  
Qualifications:

What we need from you:

* Minimum of 10 years of operations management experience, food manufacturing preferred.  
  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Food Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* Ability to apply understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral or diagram form.
* Track record of strong performance as a senior operations manager with demonstrated operations and management talent and a desire to participate in a team environment.
* Demonstrated experience in organizational and process improvement, ideally with using Lean, Kaizen, and Six Sigma concepts.
* Long term and short-term planning skills.
* Budget development and presentation skills.
* Ability to effectively analyze and evaluate new equipment and new processes and assign a value for reduced labor, yield improvement, or quality improvement.
* Negotiating strategy and skills, for dealing with vendors, union, or government personnel.
* Must be able to adapt to and become an advocate of the company mission and vision statements.
* Team member who will quickly earn and maintain the personal and professional respect of people inside and outside the Company.
* Articulate and effective communicator with the ability to influence others through the employment of sound judgment.
* Maintains professional demeanor, high standards of integrity, honesty, loyalty, and ethical values.

What you'll receive from us:

* Salary within the range of $160,000 - $175,000, depending on experience\*
* Unlimited PTO\*
* Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
* Company Paid Life Insurance
* Telehealth Services
* 401K Matching
* FSA & HSA available
* EAP and wellbeing support
* Tuition reimbursement program available

* *The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range of candidates hired. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. Most candidates will start in the bottom half of the range. Unlimited PTO requests are subject to approval and is subject to the current business needs of CTI Foods.*

* Monitors production, inventory, safety, HR, QA, maintenance, and sanitation programs.

* Explore, propose, and lead the implementation of new process and packaging technology for desserts.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**

* Ability to manage a diverse staff of managerial personnel.

* Experience with self-directed teams/skill-based pay.

existing_roles.title: Head of Production
existing_roles.description:
**WHO WE ARE**  
At Ghirardelli, we honor tradition and drive innovation, aiming to be the top choice for premium chocolate. Our commitment to *Making Life A Bite Better* inspires both our products and the way we do business. We support personal and professional growth, recognizing that each employee’s contribution directly impacts Ghirardelli’s growth and success. Join our dynamic team and help shape Ghirardelli's future.

**Job Summary**

The Head of Production is accountable for safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective production across all three shifts of the factory. This role leads the production organization, establishes consistent operating standards and management routines across shifts, and ensures delivery of safety, food safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, waste, and people objectives.

The Head of Production translates factory strategy into clear production priorities, develops leadership capability throughout the production organization, creates the accountability required for sustained execution and deliver on key organizational metrics. The role partners and collaborates cross-functionally to resolve systemic losses, strengthen operating discipline, improve asset and labor performance, and embed TPM and continuous improvement practices into daily operations.

  

* Establish and sustain a culture of Safety and Food Safety, shifting the mindset to one of immediate intervention, learning, correction, and prevention of unsafe behaviors or conditions.
* Ensure production leaders visibly demonstrate safety and food-safety leadership on every shift
* Ensure timely containment, investigation, corrective action, and verification following significant incidents or deviations
* Partner with Safety and Quality to ensure standards are understood, implemented, audited, and sustained
* Ensure production readiness for internal, customer, and regulatory audits
* Lead, coach, and develop the production team to ensure clear expectations, accountability, and effective succession plans
* Establish consistent leadership expectations and operating discipline across all three shifts
* Ensure recognition, coaching, corrective action, and performance management are applied consistently across shifts
* Create an environment where standards are understood, leaders address deviations promptly, and follow-through is visible
* Identify systemic losses and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented
* Sponsor cross-functional improvement teams addressing systemic production losses
* Lead the AM pillar implementation into the culture and mindset of the factory
* Verify that corrective actions address root causes and prevent recurrence across applicable shifts and production areas
* Drive recovery plans when production performance deviates from plan
* Manage production spending, labor, overtime, material variances, and productivity commitments
* Ensure production capacity, labor capability, and operating constraints are represented in annual and long-term planning
* Partner with Maintenance and Reliability to align production plans, preventive maintenance, equipment access, shutdown execution, and chronic-loss elimination
* Partner with Planning and Warehouse to align production schedules, material availability, inventory requirements, and service priorities
* Partner with Quality to manage holds, deviations, and release priorities
* Partner with Engineering on design reviews, commissioning, qualifications, start-up, stabilization, and operational handoff of capital projects
* Partner with Training on workforce planning, leadership capability, and capability development plans
* Partner with HR and factory leadership on labor relations, grievance resolution, contract administration, negotiations, mediation, and arbitration, as required.
* Hire, develop and manage performance of team. Create an inclusive environment that embraces our values and purpose.
* Ensure reconciliation of production workorders and partner with finance function to reconcile and resolve any losses
* Partner with IP team for execution of projects to systematically reduce waste across processing and packaging streams
* Enable a proactive, positive, collaborative and engaged culture across all levels of the production organization
* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned or as necessary.

Minimum Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations management, food science, supply chain, business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience in a complex, multi-shift operation
* Experience leading managers and an organization with multiple levels of leadership
* Demonstrated accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, productivity and people results
* Experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated manufacturing environment
* Working knowledge of food-safety systems, manufacturing quality systems, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Experience applying Lean, TPM, or another structured continuous-improvement system
* Experience with labor planning, operating budgets, and performance management
* Ability to lead effectively in a union-represented environment

Other Job Requirements

* Regular presence in manufacturing and production areas is required
* Flexibility to work across all three shifts to provide leadership visibility, conduct reviews, coach leaders, and respond to operational needs.
* Availability outside of normal business hours for significant safety, food safety, quality, people, equipment, or service events
* Ability to operate in manufacturing environments involving noise, heat, cold, moving equipment, stairs, elevated areas, and required PPE
* Limited travel may be required for business meetings, training, supplier visits, benchmarking, or project support

Salary: $168766 to $219374

To learn more about our benefits visit Corporate Careers | Ghirardelli, and select "Learn More" under Corporate, Manufacturing or Restaurant & Retail.

Ghirardelli's salary range reflects market rates based on our size, revenue, and location. Starting pay is determined using a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, job-related skills, knowledge, and experience as well as market conditions. A bonus and/or long-term incentive may be included as part of this compensation package.

Ghirardelli is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other classification protected by state, local or federal law. Where permitted by law, applicants for this position may be required to undergo job‑related background and drug screening. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with relevant state and local fair chance laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the New York City Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

existing_roles.description:
LISI AEROSPACE is ranked 60th in the global aerospace value chain and specializes in the design and manufacture of high-tech metal components to enhance aircraft safety and performance. Active since 1950 in the fastener market (no. 3 worldwide), LISI AEROSPACE has been a recognized player in metal components for aircraft engines and airframes since 2011. With its dedication to industrial excellence, LISI AEROSPACE aims to become a leader in costs, quality, deadlines and workplace safety. SUMMARY
  
The Director of Manufacturing is responsible for production, delivery and quality of highly engineered aerospace fasteners, utilizing machining, forging, thermal treatment and coating operations. In addition to these responsibilities, the Director of Manufacturing will also be responsible for safety, environmental results, efficiencies and effectiveness of the assigned production unit and/or groups. The individual will act as a senior management representative in the assigned production units and ensure that company policies and guidelines are accurately interpreted and implemented. Develops and implements optimal, cost-effective manufacturing processes and methods in accordance with product specifications and quality standards. Minimize process variation and maximize efficiency of both existing and new product manufacturing process.

Ways of Working, Experience, and Behaviors
  
  
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

* Technical Skills – Technical knowledge including but not limited, to specification interpretation, product application, product quality, quality systems, International Standards, safety and environmental management, customer relationship management, project management, Lean concepts, Six-Sigma, and people development and leadership.
* Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens intently to others and seeks clarification; Provides clear and pleasant responses to inquiries regardless of the situation; Presents complex concepts in a simple manner to achieve understanding at all levels of the organization. Demonstrates group presentation skills working in a global environment; actively participates in meetings providing clear information.

Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Places success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed; Follows the company guiding principles and values; Recognizes accomplishments of team members.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the HSE responsibility, organization's policies and applicable laws; Responsibilities include but are not limited to interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  
  
ESSENTIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  
  
Education and/or Experience

existing_roles.description:
**At ACI we build our company and our culture not by counting people, but by making our people count!**

Atlantic Constructors is seeking dynamic, motivated, career minded individuals to join our expanding team! Atlantic Constructors has been recognized as an industry leader in the Mid-Atlantic Region for over 50 years.

**Benefits:**

* ***$0.00 COST FOR MEDICAL, DENTAL, SHORT TERM DISABILITYLIFE INSURANCE (EMPLOYEE ONLY) COVERAGE!***
* Dental Insurance Plan
* Vision Insurance Plan
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with Generous Company Matching
* Health Savings Plan with Generous Company Matching
* Wellness Programs

Atlantic Constructors offers competitive benefits, for more information check out our comprehensive list on our website. ACIBuilds.com

**Role Overview:**
==================

The Director of Offsite Production is responsible for the leadership, performance, and continued growth of offsite production across company facilities. The role oversees carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication and non-volumetric prefabrication and manufacturing, including pipe racks, equipment skids, supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies. The Director establishes the operating systems, production standards, capacity, and cross-functional coordination required to deliver safe, compliant, high-quality work on schedule.

This leader is accountable for implementing improvements that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability. The Director will implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, eliminate waste and production constraints, reduce rework, and create repeatable processes that support scalable offsite manufacturing. The position works closely with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, and field operations to align production with project and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Offsite Production Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Provide enterprise leadership for pipe fabrication, prefabrication, and manufacturing operations across company facilities and approved external production partners.
* Translate backlog, project schedules, and sales forecasts into capacity plans, staffing requirements, production priorities, and facility needs.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for production planning, readiness reviews, constraint management, performance reporting, and executive escalation.
* Develop scalable operating standards that support growth while maintaining safety, quality, cost control, and predictable delivery performance.
* Coordinate work across facilities to balance demand, available labor, equipment, and production capability.

**Pipe Fabrication Operations**
-------------------------------

* Direct carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication operations, including material receiving, cutting, beveling, fit-up, welding, inspection, testing, coating coordination, staging, and shipment.
* Ensure spool sequencing, production release, shop loading, and work packaging align with approved drawings, project priorities, and field installation requirements.
* Maintain compliance with applicable codes, specifications, welding procedures, ASME and AWS requirements, customer quality plans, and company standards.
* Improve material traceability, weld documentation, inspection records, testing status, and turnover packages for fabricated systems.

**Prefabrication and Manufacturing Operations**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead production of non-volumetric prefabricated assemblies, including pipe racks, equipment skids, structural supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies.
* Develop repeatable production cells, workstations, tooling, fixtures, travelers, and assembly sequences that improve flow and reduce variation.
* Ensure manufacturing plans account for structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, insulation, coatings, testing, preservation, packaging, and logistics requirements, as applicable.
* Support the transition of first-of-a-kind work into stable, repeatable production through lessons learned, standardized design, and controlled process updates.

**Production Planning and Readiness**
-------------------------------------

* Establish production-readiness criteria to confirm approved drawings, bills of material, work instructions, quality requirements, tooling, materials, and labor are available before work is released.
* Partner with Engineering and VDC to improve constructability, spool and assembly breakdown, drawing release sequencing, and design for manufacturing and assembly.
* Coordinate with Procurement and material-control teams to maintain visibility to shortages, supplier commitments, receiving status, kitting, and point-of-use material availability.
* Identify production constraints early, assign recovery actions, and communicate schedule or capacity risks to Project Management and executive leadership.
* Maintain production schedules that clearly identify priorities, dependencies, resource loading, planned output, and required shipment dates.

**Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement**
-------------------------------------------------

* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability across all offsite operations.
* Implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, including 5S, standard work, value-stream mapping, visual management, cellular production, daily tiered accountability, Kaizen events, mistake-proofing, and continuous-flow principles.
* Evaluate workflows, facility layouts, material movement, staffing, tooling, and equipment utilization to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, waste, waiting, excess handling, rework, and other non-value-added activity.
* Use time studies, cycle-time analysis, workload balancing, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving to improve production performance and reduce manufacturing lead time.
* Develop and maintain standard work instructions and repeatable manufacturing processes that improve safety, quality, training effectiveness, and output predictability.
* Lead initiatives to reduce setup and changeover time, control work in process, improve material flow, and increase productive labor utilization.
* Maintain an improvement pipeline with defined owners, target benefits, implementation dates, and verified results; ensure completed improvements are standardized and sustained.
* Evaluate and implement automation, machinery, software, tooling, and manufacturing technologies that improve safety, quality, efficiency, and capacity.

**Throughput Capacity and Performance Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Establish production targets and capacity models based on takt time, cycle time, labor availability, equipment constraints, facility limits, and project demand.
* Track and improve key performance indicators such as safety performance, labor hours per spool or assembly, plan attainment, throughput, work in process, first-pass yield, rework, equipment utilization, and on-time completion and shipment.
* Develop visual dashboards and tiered performance reviews that provide timely, accurate information to supervisors, project teams, and executive leadership.
* Analyze performance gaps, determine root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions, and verify that results are sustained.
* Use production data to validate estimating assumptions, workforce plans, capital investments, and future capacity requirements.

**Supplier and External Fabrication Partner Management**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Qualify, onboard, and manage third-party fabrication and manufacturing partners when additional capacity or specialized capability is required.
* Define scopes of work, quality requirements, documentation, inspection points, schedule expectations, material responsibilities, and delivery requirements for outsourced work.
* Monitor supplier performance for safety, quality, responsiveness, cost, schedule adherence, and corrective-action closure.
* Coordinate external production with internal Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and logistics teams.

**Estimating and Preconstruction Support**
------------------------------------------

* Support Estimating and Preconstruction with production strategies, labor assumptions, production rates, facility requirements, tooling, equipment, subcontract capacity, and logistics considerations.
* Review proposed scope, drawings, specifications, and schedules to identify production risks, constructability issues, testing requirements, and opportunities for prefabrication or standardization.
* Provide fact-based labor and throughput data to improve estimate accuracy and establish achievable production commitments.
* Participate in make-or-buy decisions and recommend the most effective production approach based on capability, capacity, cost, risk, and schedule.

**Quality Safety and Delivery**
-------------------------------

* Promote a production culture in which safety, quality, and operational discipline are built into the process and are never traded for output.
* Partner with Safety and Quality leaders to establish training, inspections, hold points, audits, nonconformance controls, and corrective-action processes.
* Ensure completed work is inspected, tested, documented, preserved, packaged, and released in accordance with project and company requirements.
* Drive reduction of defects, weld repairs, material damage, punch-list items, field rework, and incomplete turnover documentation.
* Coordinate staging, loading, transportation readiness, and shipment sequencing to support safe handling and efficient field installation.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Build and lead an accountable organization of production managers, superintendents, supervisors, planners, coordinators, and skilled craft professionals.
* Define roles, decision rights, staffing plans, performance expectations, and development paths for the offsite production team.
* Train leaders and production personnel in Lean principles, standard work, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, visual management, and data-driven decision-making.
* Develop succession plans and cross-training programs that increase workforce flexibility and reduce dependency on single points of knowledge.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, teamwork, continuous improvement, and respect for people.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, manufacturing, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience in fabrication, prefabrication, manufacturing, construction operations, or a closely related production environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated success improving production throughput, labor productivity, quality, schedule performance, and operating discipline.
* Practical experience implementing Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement systems in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of pipe fabrication, welding, structural fabrication, production planning, material control, quality systems, and shop operations.
* Ability to build capacity plans, interpret production data, identify constraints, and translate performance information into corrective action.
* Experience coordinating with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, suppliers, and field teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, financial, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent formal training in Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ASME, AWS, weld-quality programs, fabrication codes, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Experience with production-planning, ERP, manufacturing execution, scheduling, and performance-dashboard systems.
* Working knowledge of fabrication and detailing platforms such as Stratus, Tekla, SpoolFab, or comparable systems.
* Experience establishing or expanding multi-facility prefabrication and manufacturing operations.
* Experience implementing automation, advanced tooling, production-line design, and capital improvement projects

Visit us at www.acibuilds.com for more information!

existing_roles.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Technical Operations, you’ll own manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations. We build hundreds of robots a year today and need to build a lot more. You’ll own how we get there, including the teams, suppliers and facilities, and work closely with engineering along the way.

You’ll report to the CTO. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Scaling production from hundreds of robots a year to many more
* Manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations
* The teams, suppliers and facilities behind production
* A close partnership with engineering

**Requirements**
----------------

* Ran manufacturing or operations at a company that builds complex hardware in volume
* Built an operations function and hired the people who run it
* Been responsible for a fleet of products in the field, including service and support
* Sets clear targets and hires well
* Comfortable on a factory floor

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, or other products that combine hardware and software
* Experience with contract manufacturers
* Experience with quality systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

  + Ensure all “work in process” is properly tagged in accordance with procedures and instructions.
  + Receive and review daily shift reports from leadership team and address areas of concern.
* Ensure the production floor is well equipped, well maintained and efficiently designed

**About Us:**

  

**Tidal Vision:**

We believe that sustainability should not require customers to compromise on price, convenience, or performance. Our mission is to create positive and systemic environmental impact by making our biopolymer solutions cost competitive, more convenient, and better performing than the synthetic chemicals we displace. We value innovation and take pride in challenging the status-quo; we choose to view obstacles as opportunities. We value new ideas and encourage the team to apply creativity and invent new solutions to meet challenging demands. We value open, direct communication and foster a collaborative working environment through our unique approach to work culture. We value our employees and demonstrate that through our compensation and benefits programs and opportunities for growth and development.

  

**About Cesco Solutions**:  
Cesco Solutions is the leader in creating client value in liquid/solids industrial water and process applications. Specializing in industries such as food & beverage, paper process and high-organics wastewater overall, we focus on eliminating waste/sludge through reduction and upcycling, at the same time, reducing contamination of downstream biological systems so they run more effectively and efficiently.

As part of Tidal Vision, Cesco leverages chitosan-based chemistry as a sustainable resource recovery approach, to traditional synthetic and metal-based chemistry, to improve paper strength, waste clarification, reduce sludge, and enhance treatment efficiency. By combining advanced chemistry, application expertise, and operational support, Cesco helps facilities optimize wastewater performance, lower chemical consumption, and maintain regulatory compliance while advancing more sustainable treatment practices.

  

**About Tidal Vision’s Unique Work Culture:**

Tidal Vision strives to build and invest in the highest performing and most innovative team. We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Plant Manager to lead the operations of our seafood processing facility in Dutch Harbor, AK. This individual will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of plant operations, including production, food safety, quality assurance, maintenance, staffing, inventory management, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with experience managing manufacturing or food processing operations, preferably within the seafood, meat, poultry, dairy, or other protein processing industries. This role requires a strong commitment to employee development, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and delivering high-quality products to customers.

**Travel required to Dutch Harbor approximately 67% of the year in various intervals, with Dutch Harbor onsite per day bonus pay. Food and lodging provided.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operations Leadership:**

* Direct and oversee all daily plant operations to ensure production goals, quality standards, and customer commitments are achieved.

* Develop production schedules that maximize throughput, efficiency, and product quality while minimizing downtime and waste.

* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to safety, productivity, labor efficiency, yield, quality, and on-time delivery.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and reduce costs.

* Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, maintenance, quality, and sales teams to ensure seamless operations.

  

**Team Leadership:**

* Lead, coach, and develop hourly production employees.

* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, employee engagement, and operational excellence.

* Conduct performance evaluations, succession planning, and leadership development activities.

* Recruit, train, and retain a high-performing workforce.

* Promote open communication and maintain positive employee relations.

  

**Food Safety & Quality:**

* Ensure compliance with all food safety and quality standards, including HACCP, FDA, USDA (where applicable), GMPs, SSOPs, and sanitation requirements.

* Support internal and external audits while maintaining regulatory compliance.

* Partner with Quality Assurance to investigate product issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

* Foster a culture where food safety and product quality are prioritized throughout the organization.

  

**Safety & Compliance:**

* Champion a strong workplace safety culture by ensuring compliance with OSHA regulations and company safety policies.

* Lead safety meetings, incident investigations, and corrective action initiatives.

* Maintain compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.

  

**Financial & Operational Performance**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operating expenses.

* Monitor labor costs, production yields, inventory levels, and operating efficiencies.

* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through process optimization and waste reduction.

* Prepare operational reports and present plant performance to senior leadership.

  

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement:**

* Partner with maintenance teams to ensure equipment reliability and minimize downtime.

* Support preventive maintenance programs and capital improvement projects.

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, quality, and operational excellence.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing or food processing leadership experience.

* Strong leadership, communication, and employee development skills.

* Experience managing production schedules, labor planning, inventory, and operational budgets.

* Knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP, GMPs, sanitation programs, and quality systems.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with frozen, fresh, or value-added seafood products.

* Knowledge of seafood handling, cold chain management, and traceability requirements.

The Plant Manager is responsible for overseeing daily department operations, leading warehouse team members, and ensuring manufacturing objectives are met safely, efficiently, and within established quality standards. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, business acumen, problem-solving skills, and the ability to make independent decisions that support operational success.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and promote the company's safety programs to maintain a safe, healthy, and accident-free work environment.
* Manage daily department operations and direct the work of assigned employees and subordinate supervisors, as applicable.
* Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability for team members.
* Provide leadership in employee relations matters, including addressing grievances, resolving complaints, and recommending appropriate personnel actions.
* Communicate departmental and plant-wide goals, priorities, and performance expectations effectively.
* Review production orders, schedules, product specifications, quantities, and delivery requirements to plan departmental operations.
* Establish production priorities, sequencing, and schedules to support manufacturing efficiency and customer requirements.
* Coordinate manufacturing activities to ensure production and quality standards are consistently achieved.
* Monitor production scrap, operating reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify and resolve operational, manufacturing, and maintenance issues to minimize costs, reduce delays, and improve productivity.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence.
* Monitor departmental performance and business metrics to support overall plant and company objectives.

* 3–5 years of recent supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience with continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
* Strong business acumen, including an understanding of profit and loss (P&L), KPIs, and business performance metrics.
* Proven ability to build effective teams, establish expectations, and hold employees accountable.
* Strong production knowledge and the ability to lead, motivate, and develop team members.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to exercise independent judgment within the scope of departmental responsibilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with individuals and groups.
* Ability to understand and work with mathematical equations and production data.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in distribution warehouses.
* Experience with ERP systems and ERP implementation.
* Experience using production data and operational metrics to drive business decisions and continuous improvement.

The Plant Manager is expected to lead by example, foster a positive and accountable work environment, develop team capabilities, and consistently support the company's safety, quality, delivery, and productivity objectives.
